prose: LangChain shipped Managed Deep Agents v0.8 with new auth, memory and channels, alongside customer testimonials. Kyth.ai's CTO says their production chat app runs as a Managed Deep Agent, with Context Hub and user-level memory keeping client confidentiality intact.

Another user calls it 'by far the most complete agent platform, end to end': Slack integration worked perfectly, and they deployed multiple agents with custom MCP servers to production using the CLI and GitHub Actions, achieving always-on triage with the right model access.
highlights: Managed Deep Agents v0.8: new auth, memory and channels.
Kyth.ai runs its production chat app as a Managed Deep Agent.
Context Hub and user-level memory support client confidentiality.
Praised for Slack integration and CLI/GitHub Actions deploys.
Users run always-on triage with custom MCP servers.
